speedNotes: Speed varies by archetype. B/R Klingons and R/W Command want to end the game early with haste and wide boards, while U/B, W/U, and G/U play longer games as Spacecraft, modal spells, and land counts come online. Treat this as a starting point until real prerelease results arrive.

mechanics.name: Surveil
mechanics.rulesText: Surveil N means "Look at the top N cards of your library, then put any number of them into your graveyard and the rest on top of your library in any order."
mechanics.reminderText: (Look at the top two cards of your library, then put any number of them into your graveyard and the rest on top of your library in any order.)

mechanics.name: Station
mechanics.rulesText: Station is an activated ability of Spacecraft: "Tap another creature you control: Put charge counters equal to its power on this permanent. Activate only as a sorcery." Each striation, such as 6+, grants its abilities once the permanent has that many charge counters, and a striation with a power and toughness makes it an artifact creature.
mechanics.reminderText: (Tap another creature you control: Put charge counters equal to its power on this Spacecraft. Station only as a sorcery. It's an artifact creature at 6+.)

mechanics.name: Strange new worlds
mechanics.rulesText: Strange new worlds is an ability word. Its abilities count the number of differently named lands you control.

mechanics.name: Beam me up
mechanics.rulesText: Beam me up [cost] means "You may cast this card from your graveyard by paying [cost] and returning a creature you control to its owner's hand. If you do, exile it as it leaves the stack." It appears on instants and sorceries, and normal timing rules still apply.
mechanics.reminderText: (You may cast this card from your graveyard for [cost] if you also return a creature you control to its owner's hand. Then exile this spell.)

mechanics.name: Landfall
mechanics.rulesText: Landfall is an ability word. Its abilities trigger whenever a land enters the battlefield under your control, whether it was played or put there by an effect.

mechanics.name: Face a dilemma
mechanics.rulesText: You face a dilemma whenever you choose one or more modes for a modal spell or ability. Choosing several modes is still one dilemma. "Whenever you face a dilemma" triggers resolve before the spell or ability that caused them.
mechanics.reminderText: (You face a dilemma as you choose one or more modes for a spell or ability.)

mechanics.name: Federation
mechanics.rulesText: Federation is an ability word. Its abilities count the number of creature types among non-Borg creatures you control.

mechanics.name: Assimilate
mechanics.rulesText: To assimilate a creature or creature card, put it onto the battlefield under your control, or gain control of it, with a +1/+1 counter. It becomes a Borg artifact creature and loses all other creature types.
mechanics.reminderText: (To assimilate a card, put it onto the battlefield under your control with a +1/+1 counter. It's a Borg artifact creature and loses all other creature types.)

archetypes.name: Spacecraft and Artificers
archetypes.plan: Play creatures with useful enters effects, then tap them to station Spacecraft. Hold the board while the ships come online over a turn or two.

archetypes.name: Dilemma Control
archetypes.plan: Choose between proactive and reactive modes on modal spells to stay in control, then win with cards that pay off each time you face a dilemma.

archetypes.name: Klingons and Dies
archetypes.plan: Attack with hasty Klingon Warrior tokens, then sacrifice them or let them die for value. Some creatures want to die.

archetypes.name: Away Team Landfall
archetypes.plan: Put lands onto the battlefield as often as possible and turn each landfall trigger into damage or bigger creatures. Trigger doublers make it explosive.

archetypes.name: Doctors and Counters
archetypes.plan: Grow creatures with +1/+1 counters. Payoffs that care about any kind of counter also count the charge counters on Spacecraft.

archetypes.name: Borg Artifact Creatures
archetypes.plan: Build a board of Borg artifact creatures, pump them together, and sacrifice artifacts you no longer need for bigger effects.

archetypes.name: Scientists and Noncreatures
archetypes.plan: Cast cheap noncreature spells every turn to trigger Scientist payoffs. Spacecraft count as noncreature spells when cast.

archetypes.name: Archaeology Graveyard
archetypes.plan: Fill the graveyard with creatures and artifacts, surveil every turn, and bring the best cards back with reanimation and beam me up spells.

archetypes.name: Command
archetypes.plan: Go wide with Officer tokens until your creatures total 8 or more power, then use the command payoffs to break through blockers.

archetypes.name: Strange New Worlds
archetypes.plan: Play as many differently named lands as you can, including Planets and Anomalies. Off-color Planets are worth playing for their life gain and to power up strange new worlds cards.
